# 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline

> > The 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline provides free, confidential 24/7 crisis support via call, text, and chat for people experiencing mental health emergencies, suicidal thoughts, or emotional distress.

Operated by Vibrant Emotional Health and funded by SAMHSA, 988 connects individuals to trained crisis counselors through a nationwide network of crisis centers. The service offers specialized support for veterans, Deaf/Hard of Hearing individuals, Spanish speakers, and diverse communities including AANHPI populations.

## Key Topics

- 988 Lifeline
- Suicide prevention

- Veterans Crisis Line

## Getting Help & What to Expect

- [988 Lifeline Homepage](https://988lifeline.org): Homepage for 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline national mental health hotline
- [What to Expect](https://988lifeline.org/get-help/what-to-expect): Guide to calling, texting, or chatting with 988 Lifeline crisis counselors
- [Contact Us](https://988lifeline.org/contact-us): Contact form for questions, testimonials, and non-crisis inquiries

## Accessibility & Language Services

- [Deaf, Hard of Hearing, Hearing Loss](https://988lifeline.org/deaf-hard-of-hearing-hearing-loss): Videophone and VRS accessibility services for Deaf/Hard of Hearing users
- [FAQ: Multilingual Support](https://988lifeline.org/faq/calling-the-988-lifeline/faq-is-the-988-lifeline-available-in-other-languages-for-non-english-speakers): Spanish services and multilingual support via Language Line Solutions
- [FAQ: Legacy Number Still Works](https://988lifeline.org/faq/about-us/faq-does-1-800-273-talk-8255-still-work): Legacy National Suicide Prevention Lifeline number still operational

## Specialized Support & Communities

- [Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander](https://988lifeline.org/help-yourself/asian-american-native-hawaiian-and-pacific-islander): AANHPI-specific mental health resources and culturally competent support
- [Maternal Mental Health](https://988lifeline.org/help-yourself/maternal-mental-health): Perinatal and postpartum mental health resources and crisis support
- [988 Day](https://988lifeline.org/988-day): 9/8 Day of Action campaign to raise awareness about 988 Lifeline services

## Frequently Asked Questions

- [FAQ: Text Services Availability](https://988lifeline.org/faq/texting-the-988-lifeline/faq-when-are-988-lifeline-text-services-available): 988 text services available 24/7 for crisis support
- [FAQ: Connection Troubleshooting](https://988lifeline.org/faq/calling-the-988-lifeline/faq-what-do-i-do-if-i-have-trouble-connecting-when-i-call): Troubleshooting connection issues and alternative crisis contact methods
- [FAQ: Coverage Without Local Centers](https://988lifeline.org/faq/calling-the-988-lifeline/faq-is-the-988-lifeline-service-still-available-in-a-state-or-an-area-that-does-not-have-a-crisis-center-participating-in-the-988-lifeline-network): 988 Lifeline coverage available nationwide regardless of local centers
- [FAQ: Phone Bill Privacy](https://988lifeline.org/faq/calling-the-988-lifeline/faq-will-the-988-lifeline-number-appear-on-my-phone-bill): Phone bill privacy information varies by carrier for 988 calls
- [FAQ: Geolocation Capabilities](https://988lifeline.org/faq/about-us/faq-does-the-988-lifeline-have-geolocation-capabilities): Geolocation not enabled for 988 Lifeline to protect caller privacy

## Get Involved

- [Careers](https://988lifeline.org/get-involved/careers): Crisis counselor jobs, volunteer opportunities, and internships at centers
- [Storytelling for Suicide Prevention Checklist](https://988lifeline.org/storytelling-for-suicide-prevention-checklist): Guidelines for sharing lived experience stories safely and effectively

## Resources & Self-Care

- [Self-Care During the Holidays](https://988lifeline.org/self-care-during-the-holidays): Holiday stress management and mental wellness coping strategies

## Optional

- [Standards, Training, and Practices Committee](https://988lifeline.org/988lifeline-committees/standards-training-and-practices-committee): STPC committee developing crisis center standards and training practices
- [Disaster Distress Helpline (DDH) Steering Committee](https://988lifeline.org/988lifeline-committees/disaster-distress-helpline-ddh-steering-committee): DDH Steering Committee members and disaster behavioral health expertise
- [FAQ: Facebook Donation Refunds](https://988lifeline.org/faq/fundraising-and-donations/i-need-a-refund-for-a-donation-i-made-via-facebook-can-you-do-this): Facebook donation refund process through Facebook Payment Support
